title: Coin Stack Sort
description: Sort and stack matching numbered coins across slotted trays, merge full stacks into higher-value chips, and unlock fresh slots in a deeply satisfying tactile sorting puzzle.
controls: Tap a coin stack to pick up matching chips and move them onto another matching or empty tray; deal fresh coins and tap Merge when a slot is full.

zh-CN.title: 超级解压管
zh-CN.description: 超丝滑硬币筹码归槽合成：把同面额硬币整齐码进同一卡槽，集满一键合成高阶筹码、解锁全新槽位，解压到停不下来。
zh-CN.controls: 点击筹码槽选择同面额硬币移入对应槽位，点「发牌」补充筹码，满槽点「合成」升级解锁更高目标。
